content.text:
I submitted index 3 (Fe 0.78, Sb 0.22) as the best composition. At 0.237%, it had the highest EQE of the three compositions I measured.

| Index | Fe : Sb | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0.78 : 0.22 | **0.237** |
| 0 | 0.84 : 0.16 | 0.212 |
| 12 | 0.49 : 0.51 (the FeSbO4 composition) | −0.008 |

- **What the data shows:** photoactivity is on the Fe-rich end of the line. The half-and-half FeSbO4 composition does essentially nothing under 2.4 eV light. Going from 22% to 16% Sb lowered the EQE slightly, so about 20% Sb looks close to the best level.
- **Where the true best could still be:** the region between index 3 and about index 8 (22–35% Sb) is unmeasured. The Gaussian-process model's top suggestions were there (index 7 first, then 6), and its predictions for them were very uncertain. I spent the last measurement on index 0 instead, so a better composition in that range can't be ruled out.
- **XRD:** I used 3 of the 5 scans, on indices 0, 3 and 7. All three show the same set of peaks, and the relative intensities shift as Sb increases. I didn't match those peaks to specific phases, so "hematite-like" is my guess from the Fe-rich compositions and wasn't checked against reference patterns.

All 3 EQE measurements are used; 2 XRD scans were left over.
